newsitem.title: USA: PrimeStar rethinks launch of Cable Plus service.
newsitem.headline: PrimeStar rethinks launch of Cable Plus service.

text.p: PrimeStar Partners on Wednesday said it was re-evaluating plans to offer Cable Plus, a service that allows cable companies to supplement their service with a direct-broadcast satellite service.
The company is looking again at whether cable operators will be interested in Cable Plus, said Dan O'Brien, PrimeStar's president and chief operating officer.
Cable Plus, a TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc service, would provide customers with local television channels via existing cable lines as well as up to 100 extra channels via a satellite dish.
